title: Upper Body Push: Chest and Triceps Focus

warmup_sets: Incline Dumbbell Press: 1x10 at 50% working weight, 1x6 at 70% working weight

main_block.name: Low-Incline Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press
instructions: Keep dumbbells at a 30-degree incline with neutral grip to protect the anterior shoulder.
Control the lowering phase over 2 seconds and stop just above chest level.

main_block.name: Flat Dumbbell Press
instructions: Maintain slight elbow tuck (roughly 45 degrees) relative to torso.
Retract scapulae before initiating the press.

main_block.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Keep elbows pinned to your ribs throughout the full range of motion.
Pause for 1 second at full elbow extension.

main_block.name: Overhead Cable Face Pull
instructions: Pull rope toward eye level while externally rotating forearms.
Focus on rear deltoid and rotator cuff engagement without shrugging.

exercises: Thoracic spine extension over foam roller 2 mins
cool_down.instructions: Deep diaphragmatic breathing to lower sympathetic tone.

general_notes: All overhead vertical pressing was excluded to accommodate anterior shoulder discomfort. Prioritize controlled tempos over load increases.
